text:
claire-marketing: Heads up 7: were seeing a latency spike in EU inference thats impacting embeddings and generation calls. Ops is triaging. Need aligned customer comms + any changes to outward marketing (we have a webinar at 14:00 UTC).

 tom-ops: spike started ~11:05 UTC, increased p95 and elevated 5xx on eu-2. Rolling remediation underway (config rollback + nginx restart). No evidence of data leak. ETA unsure, will update in 20m.

 nina-cs: Priorities: (1) short status page line, (2) targeted note for Dedicated/private customers with action steps, (3) guidance for AMs.

 sophia-prod: We should not promet auto-failover. Some customers have region lock. Recommend status copy: "We are investigating elevated latency and errors in our EU inference region. If you're impacted, try retrying after 10s or contact support for routing assistance."

 matt-sales: Account teams need a one-sentence they can paste, plus a signal if we expect impact >1h.

 claire-marketing: Draft one-liner for AMs: "Experiencing elevated latency in EU inference region; engineers are investigating. ETA TBA  please open a priority ticket if you need immediate routing changes." Thoughts?

 nina-cs: change "ETA TBA" -> "expected update in 30m" so customers know when next comms come. Also add CTA for Dedicated customers: "If you are on Dedicated or Private, reply to this thread or open a ticket for priority routing."

 legal-bot: Reminder: avoid language implying SLA breach until we confirm. Use "may be impacted" not "are impacted."

 tom-ops: agree on phrasing tweak. Also add: "No customer data exposure identified." We'll post that once confirmed.

 claire-marketing: Status page suggested copy (v1):
```
Incident: Elevated latency and errors in EU inference region
Impact: Some customers may experience slow responses or request errors for generation and embeddings routed to EU.
Workaround: Retry after 10s; Dedicated/private customers can request temporary routing changes via support.
Next update: 30 minutes
```

 sophia-prod: OK but add "where permitted by customer settings" after routing changes so we don't overpromise.

 matt-sales: Also add a short internal AM script: "We're monitoring a latency issue in EU; ops are on it. If you need guaranteed routing, contact support and we'll prioritize you."

 nina-cs: I'll prep the email template. For Dedicated customers we should offer a temporary token to switch region if they need. Ops, can you support that?

 tom-ops: We can do manual routing changes for Dedicated within ~15 minutes of a ticket. Not automated.

 claire-marketing: Webinar impact: Recommend postponing the live demo portion and run Q&A + product update only; postpone the heavy perf benchmarks post-incident. Do we need exec approval?

 matt-sales: Execs will want to pause any public benchmark announcements. I'll flag to leadership.

 sophia-prod: Agree postpone benchmarks and any new performance claims until postmortem. It's fine to proceed with a product webinar focused on roadmap and use cases.

 incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-043 created  severity: medium-high  owner: tom-ops.

 nina-cs: Draft email to Dedicated list below, please edit:
```
Subject: Temporary routing assistance available during EU latency spike
Hi {{first_name}},
We're seeing elevated latency and some errors for requests routed to our EU inference region. If you are on Dedicated or Private and need a temporary routing change, please open a support ticket referencing "EU routing request" and we will prioritize the change.
Estimated next update: 30 minutes.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

 claire-marketing: Timing plan from marketing: publish status page now with the tweaked copy, send Dedicated email within 45m, AM one-liner to account teams immediately, pause benchmark/social posts until incident closed and postmortem ready. Webinar: remove benchmark slides and note that a follow-up will include perf numbers.

 tom-ops: 7 will post the 30-min update or earlier if resolved. Currently rolling back config.

 matt-sales: 7 shared AM script with leads.

 nina-cs: 7 email draft queued, will send after legal quick check.

 claire-marketing: Everyone drop :white_check_mark: when youre good with the plan so I can push updates.

 tom-ops: \u2705 ops aligned.

 sophia-prod: \u2705 product aligned.

 matt-sales: \u2705 sales aligned.

 nina-cs: \u2705 cs aligned, email scheduled pending legal signoff.

 legal-bot: \u2705 legal reviewed  no SLA language, safe to send.

 claire-marketing: Publishing status page now and will trigger the internal AM note. Thanks team  will follow up after the 30-min update.
